digest.component_or_area: tickets store fetch and CI bootstrap
propositions: Full clone of tickets costs 1.04 GiB / 59s wall / 319s CPU; blob:none filter reduces to 68.7 MiB / 14.3s (~15x reduction) and inherit partial clone config on subsequent fetches
rebar fetch cannot control clone filtering because clone is performed by actions/checkout before rebar init runs; leverage actions/checkout filter input and clone guidance instead
P1 bug: tickets fetch timeout causes silent fail-open fallthrough to orphan bootstrap, creating empty divergent store with all reads returning [] and writes unreachable from origin

blob:none is safe for rebar access patterns (whole-store verify-identity runs faster on partial clone with zero byte fetch) but git blame on bug-close path requires accepted cost of full tree availability
Fail-close mechanism replaces orphan bootstrap so uncontactable remote causes non-zero exit instead of creating diverged store
merge.ours.driver=true must land before blob:none filter to prevent silent 3-way text merge of 18 MB JSON in .bridge_state during reconcile-bridge reconverge
